build_regression_sweep: build a regression problem sweep with configurable number of seeds and initial seed value
build_classification_sweep: build a classification problem sweep with configurable tau, input dimensions, and temperature values
build_classification_2d_sweep: build a 2d classification problem sweep with varying training sizes and temperature values
build_enn_paper_sweep: build an ENN paper sweep by generating regression configs with epistemic_only enabled
test_filter_unique_configs: test the _filter_unique_configs function to deduplicate problem configs with an optional filter predicate
